title: Liability Notice Forms Used on Each Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Tier
content:
The Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program uses a different advance notice of financial liability on each tier: the form a customer must sign before an item or quantity expected to be denied can be billed to them.

| Tier | Liability notice of the tier |
|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | Not applicable |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | Plan member waiver |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | Plan member waiver |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | Organization determination required |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | Medicare Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (form CMS-R-131) |
| CGM Medicaid Program | Medicaid non-covered agreement |

## The five entries

- **Not applicable**: the tier has no liability notice.
- **Plan member waiver**: the health plan's member waiver of liability, used on both commercial tiers.
- **Organization determination required**: the entry on the CGM Medicare Advantage Program.
- **Medicare Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (form CMS-R-131)**: used on the CGM Original Medicare Program.
- **Medicaid non-covered agreement**: used on the CGM Medicaid Program.

## Points of reference

- The two commercial tiers share one form; every other tier has an entry of its own.
